company_news.headline: What's in the Offing for Ventas Stock This Earnings Season?
company_news.summary: VTR is expected to have posted higher Q2 revenues and FFO as senior housing demand and OM&R gains offset pressure from triple-net properties.

company_news.headline: Mizuho Maintains Outperform on Ventas, Raises Price Target to $104
company_news.summary: Mizuho  analyst Vikram Malhorta   maintains Ventas (NYSE:VTR) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $98 to $104.
